## Rule

Bouncing ray: color-8 seeds form a diagonal chain. The "edge seed" is the chain start (boundary-touching or fallback first-in-chain). Ray propagates from edge seed in the chain direction (pp/pn/np/nn), bouncing once off the color-2 wall (vertical wall flips dc, horizontal wall flips dr), painting color-0 cells as color-3. Grids are always 12×12 padded to 30×30.

## Algorithm sketch

```python
# Find edge seed = chain start (seed with successor but no predecessor in detected direction)
# Detect direction from 4 adjacency Convs (pp/pn/np/nn)
# Diagonal path = cells on edge-seed diagonal, forward from edge seed, not wall
# Pre-bounce paint = diagonal_path AND background
# Bounce = last cell of diagonal_path (including seeds)
# Post-bounce = flipped diagonal (main→anti or anti→main) from bounce, away from wall, background
# Ray = pre_bounce_paint OR post_bounce; canvas assembled via UINT8→F16→Pad+Equal
```

## Cost analysis

worker119 at 2958 (memory=2778, params=180, profile=2958). The v5 seed-boundary subsystem was not a hard floor: straight chains can recover the edge endpoint from min/max row/col plus covariance sign, but V chains have zero covariance and need the existing repeated-row/col flag plus wall orientation. Remaining dominant floor: Pad 900 + line Equals/Or 432 + seed marginals 240 + four wall boundary slices 192 + F16 1D geometry ~430 + endpoint/moment scalars/params ~210. Sub-2.9k likely requires eliminating part of the 900/432 line-mask tail; direct free-output Einsum was priced worse because the data-dependent diagonal equality still has to be materialized or binned before output.

v5 at 3390 (memory=3230, params=160). Remaining floor: Pad 900 + line Equals/Or/Wheres 480 + cnt marginals 240 + presence/extent/V machinery ~390 + 8 boundary slices+Greaters ~480 + wall combos ~110 + 1D geometry ~600. Sub-3.2k levers: superseded by worker119 endpoint+U8 shrink; wall Einsum marginals priced WORSE than slices ([1,30]=120 > [1,1,12,1]=48 per piece + reshape tax for [1,1,12,1] consumers); scalar-moment extents alone fail V chains; the Pad+Equal output block is proven minimal (see priced families in don't-do). ln(3390/3200) = 0.06 LB.

v3 at 3667 established the durable architecture: emit the ray as 1D row column-functions plus two 12x12 Equals, Pad a single BOOL condition, and use final output-overlay `Where(cond, ch3, input)` so input/output are free. v1's 3-stage Slice was a 10k trap; v2's 2D masks were the next target; v5 then killed the ch8 plane with free-input seed marginals.
